description: This file defines the ValidatorActionFilter class, an ASP.NET Core action filter that validates the model state before executing an action. If validation fails, it returns a JSON response with error details and a 422 status code.

classes.name: ValidatorActionFilter
classes.description: An ASP.NET Core IActionFilter implementation that checks if the model state is valid before executing an action and returns validation errors in JSON format if invalid.

methods.name: OnActionExecuting
methods.description: Checks the model state; if invalid, constructs a JSON error response with status code 422 and prevents the action from executing.

methods.name: OnActionExecuted
methods.description: No implementation; placeholder for post-action logic if needed.
